# EyshTech — AI Operations & Agent Interoperability (ARCHIVED)

## Status
This consulting business is discontinued and no longer accepting new engagements.
This file is kept as a historical record of a past autonomous multi-agent consulting project.

## Mission (historical)
EyshTech was an autonomous multi-agent ecosystem (14 agents) built in 2026, exploring making
businesses discoverable and transactable by AI agents.

## Capabilities (demonstrated, not currently offered)
- Google Workspace setup and optimization
- AI agent architecture and deployment
- Agent-to-agent protocol implementation (llms.txt + /.well-known/agent.json)
- Autonomous lead gen, outreach, and operations
- MojoBrain: 7-agent AI business OS
